errors.text: The proposed heat-treatment/B2-precipitation intervention omits the essential addition of 4.2 at.% Cr and the resulting approximately 4 vol.% reticulated Laves phase.

The baseline is materially incorrect: HfMoTaTiZr is reported as an as-cast single-phase BCC alloy with density 10.44 g/cm³ and approximately 11.6% fracture strain, not a continuous-B2, 12.5 g/cm³ alloy with less than 5% ductility.
The claimed density of approximately 10.8 g/cm³ is higher, not lower, than the actual 10.44 g/cm³ baseline and therefore does not address the stated density limitation.

Formation of B2 precipitates in Al-free Hf-Mo-Ta-Ti-Zr is asserted without direct thermodynamic or experimental evidence; the sole supporting paper concerns an Al-containing alloy whose ordering behavior is not safely transferable.
The predicted strength and ductility do not agree with the demonstrated outcome of 1750.6 MPa yield strength and 14.0% fracture strain.
